decision: The revised matrix faithfully summarizes the accepted evidence at its stated planning scope. No unresolved material numerical error or scientific overclaim was found in the checked claims. This acceptance concerns the matrix only, not completion of every research-plan stage or readiness for a new evaluation.
checks: SI-U1 65/68/67 successes over 82 TRAIN tasks, paired differences, Holm values and inconclusive classification agree with the accepted scientific summary and independent thesis review. No efficacy, equivalence, non-harm or held-out population inference is asserted.

The training-coverage audit supports matched supervised-token dose and family-level parent counts, one realized training seed per arm, and different task/state distributions. The matrix does not isolate data source as a causal factor.

The 17-task, 51-trajectory, 2206-action retrospective diagnosis and eight two-object zero-success results agree with the accepted descriptive sources; causal and whole-pipeline conclusions remain excluded.
The R19 independent review supports CONTINUE and K2 at 30/36 with different successful cases, and the retrospective 32/36 envelope; the matrix does not present this as a deployable controller gain.
The corrected canonical-hash binding and accepted-source identity findings are preserved. Candidate inclusion is not misrepresented as actual replay or training.

The later independent local/history and archive audits support 35/85 and protected 6/17 local inventories, protected 950/345 legacy plus 6 local parents minus one overlap yielding 350, and 24 valid_unseen parents. These remain metadata inventories rather than runnable independent samples.

Both scene audit reports support the reported 346/350 and 24/24 parent-label matches. The four history categories retain different evidentiary meanings: expert source identities, B/C materialization identities tied to completed-training provenance, the accepted SI-U1 evaluation schedule, and directly checked G1 trajectory identities. They are not all described as candidate execution or optimizer exposure.

The four residual parents and zero valid_unseen parents under strict label screening are conditional metadata findings, not geometric independence or a globally impossible research route. The revised text correctly says the potential future filtering rule has not been adopted or preregistered.
The cost statement agrees with the resource audit and remains a historical phase-specific figure; the device observation does not reserve hardware or estimate future cost.
The N=6 impossibility and N=40 simulations are tied to their original particular rules and assumptions, not generalized to all future designs. The added source makes this restriction traceable.

The two named prior-work claims were additionally checked against primary online sources. Re-ReST's ACL abstract explicitly reports agent self-training on ALFWorld; Sarukkai et al. v3 section 6.4 and Appendix C describe fine-tuning on self-collected databases including ALFWorld. This verifies narrow prior-art overlap, not exhaustive novelty search or reproducibility of their results.
